Frequently Asked Questions

What single change creates the most space in a tiny closet?

Switching to uniform ultra-thin velvet hangers and adding a clip-on double-hang rod extender immediately increases capacity by 50% or more with zero drilling.

How do you keep folded sweaters from toppling on a high closet shelf?

Use clip-on clear acrylic shelf dividers or move sweaters into a 6-shelf hanging cubby organizer right on the closet rod.
